title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Wednesday, 7 October 2026
description: California's new AI worker-protection laws and India Mobile Congress's focus on 6G and AI-native networks, Brodie Kostecki's bid for a Bathurst 1000 pole record and a new booking system for the Twelve Apostles, outback Queenslanders pitching to join Brisbane 2032, and construction starting on the Logan to Gold Coast Faster Rail project plus the Ben King AFL trade saga. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
